summary.title: 我负责一台用于石化园区和海上风电场甲烷泄漏巡检的短波红外成像相机前端防护窗口
summary.question: 我负责一台用于石化园区和海上风电场甲烷泄漏巡检的短波红外成像相机前端防护窗口研发。为了在白天强太阳背景下提高甲烷吸收特征的信噪比，相机需要尽可能完整地接收 1000–1700 nm 波段的短波红外信号，同时尽可能反射 300–450 nm 波段的近紫外和蓝光杂散辐射，以降低太阳散射背景和探测器的杂散响应。请在空气入射、熔融石英基底的条件下，仅使用 HfO2 和 SiO2 设计一个平面多层介质膜，膜系总层数不超过 30 层。

problem.compatibility_reason: Request specifies a planar, isotropic, linear multilayer dielectric stack solvable via transfer-matrix methods within supported wavelength ranges.
assumptions: Materials behave as linear, isotropic, non-absorbing dielectrics in the specified bands

metrics.rationale: User states '尽可能完整地接收 1000–1700 nm 波段的短波红外信号' (receive 1000-1700 nm SWIR signals as completely as possible) to improve methane absorption feature SNR.
User states '尽可能反射 300–450 nm 波段的近紫外和蓝光杂散辐射' (reflect 300-450 nm UV and blue stray radiation as much as possible) to reduce solar scattering background and detector stray response.

scoring.metric_rationale: These two metrics directly capture the dual-band spectral requirement: high transmission in the signal band (1000-1700 nm) for methane detection, and high reflection in the blocking band (300-450 nm) for solar background suppression. I deliberately chose mean metrics over worst_case because the user's phrasing ('尽可能完整', '尽可能反射') indicates overall band performance rather than point-wise guarantees. I did not use band_emissivity_contrast because the requirement is transmittance in one band and reflectance in another, not absorptance contrast between bands. No angle or polarization selectors are included since the user did not specify incidence angle or polarization state, implying normal incidence and unpolarized or default channel evaluation.
scoring.formula_rationale: 用户对 1000-1700 nm 透射率和 300-450 nm 反射率均要求“尽可能”优化，未指定主次权重。两项指标均为 0 到 1 之间的分数，量级一致，直接相加可平等对待信号获取与背景抑制这两个核心需求。两项系数均为正，确保变量增大时总分升高，符合“最大化”方向，避免引入人为权重导致排名任意性。

routes.scientific_hypothesis: A periodic HfO2/SiO2 quarter-wave stack centered at 375 nm will produce reflectance >80% in the 300-450 nm band while maintaining transmittance >85% in the 1000-1700 nm band, with performance improving monotonically as layer thicknesses approach the quarter-wave condition.
routes.design_principle: Quarter-wave stacks create photonic bandgaps at the design wavelength. A UV-centered stack naturally transmits longer wavelengths where the optical thickness becomes sub-quarter-wave. High-low index contrast (HfO2 ~2.0, SiO2 ~1.45) determines stopband width and peak reflectance.

known_risks: Refractive index values recalled approximately: HfO2 ~1.9-2.1, SiO2 ~1.45-1.48 in visible/NIR - actual dispersion data from material_catalog must be used
Quarter-wave thickness calculation depends on exact n(λ) at 375 nm which I am recalling, not looking up - physical thickness = λ0/(4×n) needs verified n values
Angle of incidence not specified in request - I assume normal incidence (0°) as a hypothesis; oblique incidence would shift band edges
Polarization not specified - I assume unpolarized light; TE/TM split at non-zero angle could affect performance
Extinction coefficients in UV band uncertain - HfO2 may have some absorption below 350 nm that I cannot confirm without data
What would settle these: material_catalog n/k dispersion curves for hfo2 and sio2 across 300-1700 nm, verified by the local registry
